Awards vary by program, and deadlines differ by row, so it helps to scan the details closely rather than assume the same rules apply across the list. You may also notice a mix of categories such as education, disability, STEM, medicine, community, and miscellaneous topics, along with study levels that can include high school seniors, college students, and graduate students. Some listings may be comparatively lighter-touch, but requirements still need to be structured on each provider application path before you apply.
